calls.comment: shop 31, past the 31-entry table: stitshop_funcs read as a shop (count = itself, 77)
Short Sword (14) in 2, Zanden (26) in 3: 2 is weaker -> 2
equal power -> 3 (falls through to the shield case)
Power Gem (10) in 4, Power Ring (20) in 5 -> 4
Gem (10) vs a crest's bonus_value (64): compared alike -> 4
slot 4 holds a crest of its group (9) -> 4
slot 5 holds a crest of its group -> 5
Bandanna into empty slot 0: bag 3 -> 2, equipped 0 -> 1
Ronin Helmet over the Bandanna: Bandanna back to the bag
take 0: the slot changes, no count moves
Claymore into slot 2 over sword + Buckler: both back, Claymore in 2 and 3, one equipped
a sword into slot 2 over the Claymore: both hand slots emptied, Claymore back once
crest 325 (group 9) into slot 5: 317 out of 5, 326 (group 9) out of 4
rings have no group rule: the Power Gem in 5 stays
item 0 into slot 1: Ronin Armor back to the bag
the Ronin set (gamestate_item_sets[0]): Power 60 + 120 = 180, Guard + 28 + 38 + 30; no set bonus
Power Gem: Power + 10 (bonus pair), Charisma + 3; a usable item (43) in slot 5 adds nothing
